classification_meaning: Credited natural-domain consequence of prior reviewed campaign proofs, not a claim of prior source publication or an independent discovery.
claim: For primitive N congruent to 2 mod 4 in the strict confocal elliptical ensemble, V=cA with c>0 and B=kA. V/B is a finite phase-independent constant exactly when k is nonzero.
essential_exception: A genuine primitive N=6, a/b=2 family has B identically zero and V nowhere zero; the ordinary quotient is undefined at every phase.
literal_everywhere_finite_reading: refuted by the exact exceptional family
